  - Wayback captures from 2013-06-07 to 2014-04-02; the rows link the last, https://web.archive.org/web/20140402061126/http://www.mbga.jp/_game_intro?game_id=12014055
  - FINAL FANTASY TACTICS S - Mobage (DeNA): a new tactics RPG, the latest of the Final Fantasy Tactics series, with pixel-art characters and a fixed-time battle system unlike a typical card social game; service provided by Square Enix; iPhone and Android supported, feature phones not; the start button goes to the Mobage install page
- http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ffts/ -- the official site, the entry's `profileUrl` (user, 2026-10-20), capture of 2014-03-20: https://web.archive.org/web/20140320170649/https://www.jp.square-enix.com/ffts/
  - Captures of 2013-04-30 onward: pre-registration (a gift character for everyone who registers before the release), then "FFT job characters in a heated strategy battle", free with item purchases, free Mobage membership required; the last captures carry the end-of-service pages
  - No Play or App Store page is known, the game ran through Mobage; both rows link the Mobage page
